name: NexRide [DIRTBIKES🚲]
desc:
NEXRIDE 🏍️

Welcome to NexRide — your ride, your style, your story.

Build your reputation, customize your bike, and carve your own path through a living, breathing city. Whether you're cruising through the streets, pushing your bike to its limits, meeting up with friends, or grinding your way to the top, the streets are yours to explore.

🏍️ Ride — Experience realistic bike physics and take on the streets.

🔧 Customize — Upgrade your performance, change your setup, and make your bike truly yours.

💰 Make Money — Work, complete deliveries, trade memecoins, and find new ways to build your wealth.

🌆 Explore — Discover a dynamic city with ambient sounds, working traffic, and an immersive urban atmosphere.

🤝 Live the Lifestyle — Ride with friends, build your reputation, and create your own story.

Your bike. Your hustle. Your city.

Welcome to NEXRIDE.

llm.loop: ride and customize a motorbike -> earn cash through work, deliveries and memecoin trading -> upgrade bike and reputation in an open city
llm.objectives: build reputation and wealth with your bike
llm.instructions: ride, customize, make money, explore the city
unique: memecoin trading inside a bike life sim
llm.thumbnails: realistic photo-like renders of a dirt bike in a city
llm.complexity_notes: realistic city with traffic and bike physics
